answers.content: For a 24-36hr hackathon, always stick to a monolithic backend (like a single Express app or Next.js API routes) to avoid distributed tracing and network latency overhead!

title: What are the key differences between monolithic and microservice architecture for hackathons?
How should a 2nd year student prepare for off-campus Tier-1 internships?

answers.content:
1. Focus heavily on Striver's SDE Sheet and LeetCode Mediums (Arrays, DP, Graphs).
2. Build 2 deep projects rather than 5 generic to-do apps.
3. Keep your LinkedIn active and start connecting with alumni 4 months before drive season.

Don't ignore Computer Fundamentals (OS, DBMS, Computer Networks). In 3rd year interviews, the difference between an offer and rejection is often how well you explain process vs thread and ACID properties.

title: Which tech stack is best for winning college hackathons in 2026/2027?

answers.content: Next.js / Supabase / Tailwind for frontend and DB, plus Gemini API or HuggingFace for rapid AI integration. Judges look at UI polish and problem-solution fit far more than complex backend infrastructure in 24 hours.
